examples.title: Label and helper text
examples.description: A visible label and linked helper copy make the purpose clear. Placeholder text is only a hint.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Default fields are 44px tall. The 36px compact size fits dense settings forms.

examples.title: Icons and affixes
examples.description: Decorative icons, prefixes and suffixes share the same field surface. The input keeps its native value.

examples.title: Controlled clear and counter
examples.description: Own value through onChange and reset it through onClear. Opt into returnFocusOnClear for continuous editing; clear fires only onClear, preserving the v1 callback contract.

examples.title: Uncontrolled clear
examples.description: defaultValue initializes a native input. Its clear action empties the field and updates the counter without creating an onChange event.

examples.title: Validation feedback
examples.description: Helper and error copy ease into place. Select a validation state to see the border and linked message change together.

examples.title: Form library invalid state
examples.description: aria-invalid=true gives the red border with or without affixes. Supply your own accessible description when the form owns the error message.

examples.title: Disabled, read-only and loading
examples.description: Disabled and loading fields block typing. Read-only text remains focusable and selectable; keep clearable unset for read-only fields.

examples.title: Password reveal
examples.description: The reveal action is a keyboard-accessible button with an explicit pressed state. Revealing never changes the password value.

examples.title: Space normalization
examples.description: Text fields collapse repeated spaces while preserving selection. Set preventConsecutiveSpaces=false for significant whitespace. IME drafts stay intact until a committed edit.

examples.title: Native form submission
examples.description: name participates in FormData and Enter submits the form. This example saves locally and displays the submitted value.
